question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He was very __inquisitive__ and wanted to know each and every detail.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 - Indifferent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"inquisitive"** means having a strong desire to learn or know more, often characterized by curiosity or eagerness to ask questions. (जिज्ञासु)

 
 
• **Example:** The child was extremely inquisitive, constantly asking how things worked.
 
 
 
• **"Indifferent"** refers to having no particular interest or concern; being unconcerned or apathetic. (उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example:** She was indifferent to the outcome of the debate as it did not affect her personally.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"inquisitive"** is **"indifferent"**, as they convey opposite meanings.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 - Indifferent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uncanny** (असामान्य): Strange or mysterious, especially in an unsettling way.

 
 
• **Example:** He had an uncanny ability to predict what would happen next.
 
 
 
• **Indiscriminate** (अंधाधुंध): Done at random or without careful judgment.
 
 
• **Example:** The indiscriminate use of pesticides is harmful to the environment.
 
 
 
• **Intelligent** (बुद्धिमान): Having or showing a high level of mental capability.
 
 
• **Example:** She is an intelligent student who always excels in her studies.
